note: Authored story regressions (#581): the known story failures of the 24 and 27 October library reviews, rewritten as synthetic reports from fictional publishers. Both levels are asserted exactly: which reports share an event (`event`) and which share a story card (`story`, else the event). A pair listed in `knownGaps` is asserted the other way round from its label, so a fix that closes a gap fails this test until the gap is removed from the list.
